name: field
title: Field
description: Label, description and error messages for a form control, linked for screen readers. Shows required fields as text and announces errors as they appear.
docs: Akso UI Field: every field needs a FieldLabel; write clear messages with <FieldError match="...">. Accessibility notes and test status: https://github.com/jfpanchi/akso-ui/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md
